verdict.rationale: Numeral documents ways to identify exposure: continuous jurisdiction monitoring, a free nexus study, and nexus-crossing alerts. It also handles registration, filing and remittance, and responds to tax mail. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions voluntary disclosure agreements, back-filing of prior periods, or any other remediation for historical uncollected liability. Detection and go-forward compliance are documented, but the remediation path this story asks about is not.
